Chapter 300: Chapter 7: The Legacy of the Eighth Layer Evolver (Subscription Requested)_2

The Taiyang True Fire that permeated every inch of air was terrifyingly powerful. The Heiyuan Clan powerhouse who had just tried to approach Lin Yuan felt as though his flesh and blood were starting to burn.

Boom.

Just as this Heiyuan Clan powerhouse thought about retreating explosively.

A right hand, formed of Taiyang True Fire, pierced through him. The terrifying power of the true fire exploded, burning the Heiyuan Clan powerhouse to nothingness.

The Taiyang True Fire converged.

It reformed into the figure of Lin Yuan.

...

“Quick, leave,”

“This human race evolver must be a top genius of the Human Civilization Alliance, not someone that ordinary Sixth Rank extremes can compare with.”

“Damn it, with his strength, if he had just revealed a little earlier, we wouldn’t have dared to take the initiative. He did it on purpose, deliberately attracting us to surround him.”

The remaining members of the Heiyuan Clan had ugly expressions on their faces; as soon as Lin Yuan unleashed the Taiyang True Fire domain and covered tens of thousands of miles.

They realized something was wrong.

It wasn’t something unusual for a Sixth Rank Evolver to master domain power, but a domain completely filled with Taiyang True Fire exerted an inconceivable suppressive force on them.

Rumble.

Several Heiyuan Clan powerhouses tried to move backward, to break free from the suppression of the Taiyang domain, but it was evidently too late.

Lin Yuan’s figure disappeared again.

He became the omnipresent Power of Taiyang.

In an instant, he condensed in front of a Heiyuan Clan powerhouse.

“Captain, save me…”

This Heiyuan Clan powerhouse only lasted a moment.

Then, he too was burned to nothingness by the Taiyang True Fire.

“I…..”

Subsequently, the last Heiyuan Clan powerhouse showed an unwilling expression, and immediately his physical soul began to burn.

As a being from the Cosmic Secret Realm Black Abyss, he had to endure countless competitions since childhood,

Barely making it out of the Black Abyss, he thought he would shine on the Battlefields of Different Races, break through to the Seventh Rank, and then return to rule a part of the Black Abyss.

But now, all was impossible.

After effortlessly killing this Heiyuan Clan powerhouse,

Lin Yuan’s gaze turned to the last Heiyuan Clan powerhouse.

Judging from the expressions of those Heiyuan Clan powerhouses just now, this one must be some sort of captain or leader.

When Lin Yuan was slaughtering the previous Heiyuan Clan powerhouses, this Heiyuan Clan powerhouse didn’t show any intention of coming to their aid.

Instead, he watched coldly as his own clansmen died.

“Impressive.”

Captain Wei Qing looked at Lin Yuan,

Even though he was in the Taiyang True Fire domain, he showed no fear,

The Taiyang True Fire, capable of burning a Sixth-Rank Peak Powerhouse to nothing, rapidly dissipated when it approached within a few feet of him.

He didn’t save the other Heiyuan Clan powerhouses just now because he wanted his clansmen to test Lin Yuan’s strength.

Competition within the Heiyuan Clan was brutal, especially after they encountered the vast cosmic environment; every member of the Heiyuan Clan had fought their way out from among countless others of their kind.

“But now, it’s time for you to die…”

The expression on Captain Wei Qing’s face revealed his cruelty.

The Heiyuan Clan had joined the Insect Race Alliance, so as long as one met the conditions, they could directly receive a gift from the Insect Race.

Among these was the killing of top genius Evolvers of the Human Civilization Alliance.

A top Sixth-Rank Evolver from the Human Civilization is even more valuable than an ordinary Seventh Rank Evolver.

“Condense.”

Captain Wei Qing believed that he had figured out Lin Yuan; the other party’s reliance was on nothing more than the Taiyang True Fire domain and the ability to turn his physical body into Taiyang True Fire.

Hum.

A wave of fluctuations began to spread out from Captain Wei Qing as the center, diffusing in all directions.

Wherever the wave passed, the Taiyang True Fire domain began to collapse, and a more potent domain power started to forcefully drive out and suppress the Taiyang True Fire domain.

“Interesting.”

Lin Yuan’s figure disappeared once again.

“Useless.”

“My clan’s Black Abyss domain can isolate everything; you can’t get in…”

Captain Wei Qing was about to speak.

The next moment.

Traces of spatial fluctuations emerged.

Lin Yuan, as if teleporting, appeared directly in front of Captain Wei Qing.

“What?”

Captain Wei Qing’s eyes widened as the Space Rules controlled by Lin Yuan, and his manipulation of power, had completely surpassed the limits of a Sixth Rank Evolver and reached the Seventh Rank realm.

In simple terms, although Lin Yuan was still exercising the power of a Sixth Rank Evolver, his understanding of the essence of power was no different from that of a Seventh Rank, and a casual strike could crush any Sixth Rank.

Chi.

Captain Wei Qing’s consciousness began to blur, and at this moment, a sense of frustration suddenly surged in his heart. As a mighty Seventh Rank powerhouse, disguising yourself as a Sixth Rank, isn’t that bullying?

Whirring.

Captain Wei Qing’s physical soul was burned to nothingness, transforming into strands of the purest essential power, which then flowed into Lin Yuan’s body.

“Storage ring.”

Lin Yuan stretched out his right hand, and Captain Wei Qing’s storage ring fell into his palm.

When he had killed the other Heiyuan Clan powerhouses just now, Lin Yuan had also conveniently collected their storage rings.

As for the physical soul, it was all incinerated by the Taiyang True Fire into the purest power and then became nourishment for the Taiyang Divine Spirit.

“No other members of the Heiyuan Clan?”

Lin Yuan closed his eyes slightly, his perception began to spread and permeate, and only after confirming that there were no other life forms within hundreds of thousands of miles, did he let out a slight sigh of relief.

“Everything was recorded just now, right?”

Lin Yuan communicated with his intelligent assistant in his mind. Human Race Evolvers in the Battlefields of Different Races would receive corresponding rewards for killing members of Different Species.

But how to prove that it was you who killed the Different Species?

That would be through the recording software installed by the three goddesses.

Just record the battle and killing process, and later, when reaching the gathering place for the Human Race on the battlefield, upload the video to the three goddesses. After their review, the number of Merit Points will be finalized.

That’s right.

Many factors, such as spatial fluctuations, affect the Battlefields of Different Races.

There are many places where one cannot connect to the three goddesses. Only after leaving the battlefield or being in a gathering place of the Human Race on the battlefield, can one reconnect with the goddesses.

“It’s just that, for what reason did these members of the Heiyuan Clan not make a move against me…”

Lin Yuan landed on the ground, frowning in thought.

The Heiyuan Clan members hadn’t immediately gone for the kill because they wanted Lin Yuan to do something for them.

And that something was something the Heiyuan Clan could not do, only Lin Yuan could…

A thought flickered in Lin Yuan’s mind.

He began to search carefully in all directions.

Half a day later.

Lin Yuan arrived in a valley.

“Just an entrance to a certain space?”

Lin Yuan observed carefully, “Considering the use of Space Rules, it should come from an Evolver of the Human Race…”

“So that’s how it is.”

Lin Yuan’s expression suddenly became clear.

Before heading to the Battlefields of Different Races.

Lin Yuan naturally wouldn’t go unprepared, with an understanding of the many opportunities on the battlefield.

One type of opportunity included treasures left behind by previous experts.

In the Battlefields of Different Races, it’s impossible to stay connected with the three goddesses in real time.

Thus, some powerful Evolvers, too severely injured to heal, would often leave their treasures somewhere before their death.

To ensure that their inheritances would not fall into the hands of Different Species, they usually left tricks that would only be accessible to the Human Race, preventing targeting by others.

“Judging by the spatial fluctuations, this space entrance has existed for at least hundreds of thousands of years. The fact that it has not collapsed over such a long period and the internal space still exists suggests that its owner’s realm was probably Eighth Layer…”

Lin Yuan speculated.

“An inheritance left by an Eighth Rank Evolver?”

Lin Yuan immediately felt anticipation, observing the space entrance. It seemed that the treasures inside were still intact; otherwise, if the treasures had been taken away, the many arrangements would likely have been cleaned up, and this space entrance probably would have collapsed long ago.

“Space entrance…”

Lin Yuan’s thoughts churned.

The space entrance led to a small space, which was carved out by a certain Evolver.

Once reaching the Seventh Rank Evolver level, one begins to comprehend the Space Rules and utilize the power of space, capable of creating a small space.

In the Immortal Tao World, the Daode Immortal Sect’s heavenly-ranked technique ‘Qiankun in the Sleeve’ is a similar application, but the space created within the sleeve can only be maintained for a short period.

For Seventh and Eighth Rank Evolvers, the small spaces they create last much longer, and even if the owner dies, they won’t collapse immediately.

“Let’s go in and have a look.”

Lin Yuan pondered for a moment, and since this was just one of his Yang Spirits, even if something went wrong, his true self could quickly reform it.

It wasn’t a risk at all.

Besides, since this space entrance was left by a member of the Human Race, Lin Yuan just needed to reveal his Human Race identity to face even fewer problems.

“What is this?”

Lin Yuan stepped forward, entering the space entrance. Looking ahead, his expression changed slightly.
